title: Radio, We Still Love You!
body:
To our listeners and community,

Our broadcast transmitter unexpectedly **ceased operation last Sunday, September 27**. As a result, our over-the-air signal at 91.3 FM is currently offline while we resolve the issue.

While our physical transmitter is down, **our commitment to bringing you the very best in alternative, indie, and underground music hasn't changed.**

---

### **Keep Tuning In: Our Web Stream is Live 24/7!**

You don't have to miss a single minute. Our **online web stream remains fully operational**, so you can continue listening from your phone, computer, or smart devices.


### **What We're Doing & Next Steps**

We are actively working on getting the transmitter inspected and repaired as quickly as possible. We are evaluating all technical options to ensure we return to the airwaves with a strong, reliable signal.

We will post further updates right here on the website as repairs progress. Thank you for your patience, flexibility, and continued support of college radio!

*Have questions, feedback, or show requests? Feel free to reach out to us at **hello@kteq.org** or follow our official social media channels for live announcements.*

---

**Stay tuned, keep streaming, and thank you for supporting KTEQ!**

— *The KTEQ 91.3 FM Team*
excerpt: Our transmitter is down, but we're still dedicated to bringing you the very best of alternative radio.
author: KTEQ Staff
